explanation: Kilogram, Liter, Meter, and Second are all fundamental or commonly derived units within the International System of Units (SI). Dozen is a unit of quantity but is not an SI unit.

category: The Seven Wonders of the Ancient World
explanation: The Great Pyramid of Giza, Hanging Gardens of Babylon, Statue of Zeus at Olympia, and Colossus of Rhodes are all featured on the classical list of the 'Seven Wonders of the Ancient World'. The Great Wall of China, though an iconic landmark, is not part of this original ancient list.
Liter, Gallon, Quart, and Pint are all common units used to measure liquid volume. Meter is a unit of length.
